newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Rex Stores rating lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Rex Stores rating lowered.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said it lowered its intermediate-term rating on Rex Stores Inc to market performer from outperform after the company posted FY97 Q2 results of $0.16 per share versus the consensus estimate of $0.25.
--EVEREN also said it lowered its EPS estimates on the company to $1.50 from $1.70 for FY97 and to $1.75 from $2.07 for FY98.
--It reduced its intermediate and long-term target prices to $14 from $20 and $16 from $25, respectively.
